opening.argument: The video presents a paid pathway for accumulating Bitcoin and earning daily returns: the speaker calls the platform a “great way just to simply accumulate bitcoin on a day to day basis” and says the membership has produced “about 0.3 percent returns each day.” Access requires a $99 membership upgrade before users can buy into pools, while another instruction says, “Make sure you pay in Bitcoin Cash” for lifetime membership. The displayed pages reinforce that structure by showing membership benefits, GPU mining pools, an upgrade option, and a Bitcoin Cash payment request. The speaker also encourages members to share the opportunity with friends and contacts by copying a link. This evidence establishes promotion of paid mining or pool participation tied to reported returns, while it does not establish actual payouts, guaranteed future returns, completed transactions, or ownership of the displayed payment destination.
